messages:
samir_patel: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we've got recurring noisy pages from the inference autoscaler and the request-rate spikes. Need to turn cleanup notes into concrete edits + owners.

lina_zhou: Thanks. Can we list the candidate fixes here so we can assign?

samir_patel: Short list: 1) dedupe alerts by error_signature and hostpool instead of service name; 2) change the transient spike rule to require 3/5 buckets before paging; 3) add a 4m cooloff on autoscale alerts during backups; 4) create a nightly pruning job to collapse duplicate alerts older than 1h.

owen_r: I'll take (1) and (4). For dedupe-by-signature I want to use the stack_hash tag we already emit. I'll add a small script to compress duplicates into a single incident and push to alerting. Target: Tue EOD.

vera: I'll own (2) bucketed-rule change and the docs. My plan: implement a windowed rule: query: >threshold over 3 of 5m windows. I'll also add a baseline percentile (p99) check to avoid lowering thresholds too much. Target: Mon noon.

oncall-bot: Postmortem linked: PMT-2026-0827. Tracker: https://redwood.internal/trackers/pm/0827

samir_patel: For (3) autoscale cooldown I'll pair with infra oncall. Lina, can you coordinate on backup window times so we only apply cooloff during backups?

lina_zhou: Yep. Backup windows: daily 00:30-01:30 UTC and weekly snapshot Wed 03:00-04:00 UTC. I'll add suppression windows to the alerting config and document them.

owen_r: Small config snippet I'll apply for dedupe rule (yaml):
```
alert: cpu_high
match: resource:gpu-*/hostpool:inference
group_by: ["hostpool","stack_hash"]
dedupe_window: 10m
```

vera: For the bucketed rule I'll use this pseudo-query: 
```
count_over_time(rate(requests[1m]) > X)[5m:1m] >= 3
```
Then page if that expression is true.

samir_patel: Good. Putting action items into tracker now. We should also set a 72h observation window after rollout and measure pages/day and oncall interrupts. If pages/day drops >50% and latency unaffected, close.

lina_zhou: I'll add a dashboard panel showing pages/day by rule + oncall interrupts. Will post link once done.

owen_r: One more: recurring pattern note: "recurring:midnight-backups" — add monthly review with infra to tune snapshot concurrency. Owner: infra-eng (assigned: lina_zhou), due: 2026-04-12.

oncall-bot: Actions added: https://redwood.internal/trackers/alerts/2026-04-noise-sweep

vera: Timeline summary I added to tracker: 
- dedupe-by-signature -> owner: owen_r, due: 2026-03-31
- bucketed-window-rule -> owner: vera, due: 2026-03-30
- autoscale-cooloff-during-backup -> owner: samir_patel, assignee: lina_zhou, due: 2026-04-02
- nightly-prune-duplicates -> owner: owen_r, due: 2026-03-31

samir_patel: Thanks everyone. Please ping me if you need rollback steps. I'll keep this thread as the single source of status updates.

lina_zhou: Will post canary results after the first 24h.

vera: Noted. short and actionable. :thumbsup:
